body:
Found by the independent behaviour QA re-check of PR #418 (observation O6), pre-existing from #186 round 2's windowed Timeline. Low severity.

## What happens

Once a run passes 10,000 events, the Timeline's five-digit event numbers overlap the event type text. For `#10593 run.cancelled` at 1440 × 900 in Edge, the sequence text's right edge is at 92.2 px while the event type starts at 87 px (5.2 px overlap); every five-digit row collides the same way. Clicking, accessible names and event data still work.

## Expected

The sequence number and event type stay separately legible however long the run grows (long runs are the case #186 targets).

## Evidence

`docs/qa/2026-10-26-pr418-qa-recheck/README.md` ("Defect O6"), with `timeline-five-digit-overlap.png`, `timeline-layout.json` and `timeline-layout.mjs` on `main`.
